scope: Registered internal saved-data analysis of twelve warming histories and twelve statics. No simulation, physical causality, validation, grid convergence, mass, pressure universality or memory-erasure claim.

reusedDefinitions.changes: Row selection and joint D; full/half/quarter windows; explicit coverage before unchanged window function; packaging and the same independent bracket difference arithmetic used by October18 summarize.mjs.

definitions.geometry: Inclusive axial/lateral center spans from recorded lattice coordinates. Subtracting inclusive spans cancels the one-cell offset. Multiply span increments by dxUm=.35 for micrometres. Occupied-site count is not deposited mass.
definitions.event: Completed trigger-cycle attachment precedes the event; the event state is inherited and is subtracted from post-event increments.
definitions.bracket: Existing bracketCavityTime; at-or-before estimates plus adjacent-event alternatives without interpolation. Exact event times use only their exact state. Bounds are observation sensitivities, not statistical uncertainty.
definitions.contrast: a minus b; minimum a bracket increment minus maximum b, and maximum a minus minimum b. Conservative independent endpoint alternatives.
definitions.window: One minimum post-event duration across all twelve histories. Same D for all references; unavailable source-static windows are explicit and never clamped.
